text:
maria: Thanks everyone for joining the Q&A stream — posting a short follow-up here for the hiring/org questions we didn't get to in the live session. I'll answer in thread.

dan: Quick one to start — can you confirm whether the engineering headcount target for H2 changed after the org shuffle?

maria: Short answer: the company target is unchanged. We're still aiming to grow engineering headcount ~7-10% over the next two quarters, but allocation across teams shifted.

ashley: To add: we re-prioritized hiring toward infra, runtime, and platform reliability roles. Some growth slots that were originally for new product teams were reallocated.

jordan: Does that mean some teams will see hiring freezes while others accelerate?

maria: Yes — a handful of teams will pause for immediate hiring while we finish the role rationalization. Others (Dedicated, Runtime, Eng-Infra) opened up accelerated reqs.

lee: For folks on teams with a pause, what's the timeline? And are backfills still happening for critical vacancies?

ashley: Pauses are short-term (4-8 weeks) while we finalize priorities. Critical backfills (security, SRE oncall rotation, customer-facing SE roles) continue. If you’re unsure about a specific req, ping your manager + @ashley.

nate: Hiring ops note: open roles in the prior job board have been updated with new owners. If you own a req and haven’t been assigned an interviewer panel, DM me and I’ll set it up.

dan: People worried about manager realignments — we are minimizing manager changes where possible. Where reporting lines change, we’ll coordinate 1:1s and career conversations before anything goes live.

maria: We heard the concern about transparency on headcount moves. We'll publish a short headcount map with per-org deltas in Confluence tomorrow. Link will be posted here.

jordan: Can we get clarity on interview loop changes? Some teams mentioned adding a runtime-focused technical screen.

nate: Correct. For infra/runtime reqs we added a short systems design + performance interview (30m). It’s intended to be lightweight. Panel guide is under Recruiting > Interview templates.

lee: For individual contributors worried about role eliminations: will there be redeployment help or open internal conversion priority?

ashley: Yes — affected ICs get priority for redeployment interviews for 60 days and dedicated People Ops support. We have a redeployment checklist and internal role fast-track.

maria: We also committed to extra manager training on redeployment conversations and clear FAQs for impacted folks.

dan: About open headcount — we will keep the lean hiring bar but speed up for specific infra/product needs. That means stricter scoping on interview signals + faster decision SLAs (48–72h post-panel) to avoid losing candidates.

jordan: Any change to intern/hybrid hiring?

ashley: Summer intern slots are intact. We did adjust some hybrid product hires to later quarters; interns are a priority for the hiring plans.

lee: Will there be any change to compensation bands for new hires vs existing employees?

maria: No immediate changes to bands. Recruiting can use market adjustments for critical roles but comp philosophy remains the same; internal equity is a priority.

nate: If hiring managers want to request a market adjustment, use the comp request form and cc People Ops. We’ll fast-track reviews for high-priority infra hires.

jordan: Can folks expect an org chart update?

maria: Yes — chart + headcount summary tomorrow. We'll also post a short FAQ doc addressing common scenarios (redeployment, interview timeline, comp questions).

all-hands-bot: Reminder: town-hall follow-up doc uploaded to #all-hands, link pinned.

lee: Thanks — appreciate the transparency. One last ask: can we get a public list of the top 10 roles we’re prioritizing? Helps coordinate referrals.

nate: Will do. I’ll post the top-priority role list in #hiring and pin it to recruiting channel by EOD.

maria: Thanks everyone. If you have a private concern, DM People Ops or your manager. We’ll keep iterating and post the docs tomorrow. :heart:
